walkthroughs.body_html:
Mumbai brings opportunities.

It hosts the Bombay Stock Exchange, top banks and Bollywood studios.

Many move here chasing jobs in finance and media.

Growth creates housing pressure.

About 40% of residents live in informal settlements.

Authorities struggle to provide safe water and sanitation.

Transport is a huge daily issue.

The Mumbai suburban railway carries 7+ million passengers a day.

Trains are dangerously overcrowded, and roads gridlock during monsoon.
